blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is crucial for accurately diagnosing and segmenting brain tumors. However, the acquisition of CE-MRI requires injecting contrast agents, which poses potential health risks and increases scan costs. Here, we propose a CE-MRI synthesis method from non-contrast sequences, reducing both risk and cost. Unlike existing methods that rely on channel-wise concatenation to fuse multi-sequence information for synthesis, we introduce a Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module. The proposed module uses a dynamic weighting strategy to adaptively select and aggregate informative features from both individual source sequences and explicit differences among them. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that our proposed method outperforms baselines in terms of image fidelity and perceptual quality on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets. Our method successfully reconstructs tumor regions and achieves segmentation performance comparable to that obtained with real CE-MRI. Our ablation studies show that although adversarial learning improves perceptual quality, a regression-based variant of our method achieves higher structural fidelity.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (CE-MRI) is a pivotal tool that uses a contrast agent injected into the bloodstream to enhance image clarity [ 51 , 9 , 29 , 30 ] .
Although non-contrast MRI is sufficient for observing anatomical structures, it often lacks the sensitivity needed to identify vascular conditions and subtle tissue discrepancies. It is difficult to distinguish tumors or inflammation from healthy tissue on non-contrast scans because these conditions often have similar intensities [ 10 ] . CE-MRI addresses this issue by using contrast agents that make blood vessels and lesions hyperintense on T1-weighted images. This hyperintensity enables the precise identification of the location and extent of these lesions [ 38 ] .
As shown in Fig. 1 , tumor boundaries are ambiguous in other non-contrast MRI sequences, whereas the contrast-enhanced image clearly delineates the tumor region.
Despite these advantages, administering contrast agents raises safety concerns because gadolinium may not be fully excreted, potentially leading to accumulation in the brain and bones [ 25 , 40 ] . Furthermore, CE-MRI requires longer acquisition times and incurs higher costs.

blocks.en:
To address these issues, recent studies have explored generative model-based medical image translation for synthesizing CE-MRI from non-CE images [ 32 ] .
In particular, Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) [ 17 ] and diffusion model [ 21 ] based generative models have been widely investigated for synthesizing target modalities by concatenating source modalities along the channel dimension as input [ 53 , 48 , 11 , 13 , 28 ] .
Ea-GAN [ 53 ] is a 3D Pix2Pix [ 23 ] -based model that integrates edge information, effectively preserving structural details. MM-GAN [ 48 ] utilizes a 3D GAN framework that combines information from all available MRI sequences to simultaneously synthesize arbitrary missing sequences.
Chen et al. [ 11 ] have proposed a 3D convolutional network designed using a fusion method that extracts unique information feature maps through independent encoders for each input modality and then combines them in the channel direction to synthesize CE-MRI within the regression framework.
ResViT [ 13 ] has been introduced as a GAN-based generative model for multi-modal image synthesis that combines Vision Transformers [ 15 ] with the convolutional networks to leverage global context. ALDM [ 28 ] applies a 3D Latent Diffusion Model [ 46 ] incorporating switchable SPADE [ 42 ] blocks within the latent space, enabling the translation of a single source image into various target images.
Recent studies [ 44 ] have suggested that, in medical image translation, fidelity is more critical than perceptual quality because generative models for restoration tasks are subject to the perception-distortion tradeoff [ 4 ] . Accordingly, regression losses can be more important than adversarial learning, which primarily aims to improve perceptual quality [ 44 ] .

blocks.en:
Most approaches concatenate multi-sequence images along the channel dimension for use as input. This often overlooks the distinct contrast characteristics of each sequence.
For example, T1-weighted images depict fat as hyperintense, while water, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), edema, and inflammation appear dark [ 43 , 16 ] . T2-weighted images depict water, lesions, and fat as hyperintense, while air and blood appear hypointense [ 43 , 3 ] . T2-FLAIR images also highlight lesions and fat, but water and CSF appear dark [ 14 ] . Furthermore, the contrast enhancement of pathologies such as inflammation and edema varies significantly across these sequences, serving as an important biomarker [ 12 ] .
These abnormal regions can be explicitly modeled using difference maps between sequences, making them useful for accurate contrast-enhanced image synthesis.
Therefore, to accurately synthesize contrast-enhanced regions, it is crucial to explicitly incorporate the diverse contrast variations of distinct sequences and their explicit differences rather than relying on channel-wise concatenation.
Because channel-wise concatenation captures pixel-level relationships between source modalities, it can be sensitive to intensity scaling and noise. In contrast, modeling differences in a feature space can provide an enhanced contextual representation of inter-sequence contrast changes.
blocks.zh:
多数接近将通道维度上的多序列图像连接起来用作输入. 这往往忽略了每个序列的鲜明对比特征.
例如,T1加权图像将脂肪描绘为高强度,而水,脑脊液(CSF),水肿和炎症则呈现出黑暗[43,16]. T2加权图像将水,损伤和脂肪描绘为超强度,而空气和血液则显得低温 [43,3]. T2-FLAIR相片也凸显出损伤和脂肪,但水和CSF显得很暗 [14]. 此外,炎症和水肿等病理的对比增强在这些序列中差异很大,成为重要的生物标志[12].
这些异常区域可以明确使用序列之间的相差图来建模,使其可用于精确的对比增强图像合成.
因此,为了准确地综合对比性增强的区域,必须明确纳入不同序列的不同对比性差异及其明显的差异,而不要依赖顺道取悦。
由于信道相通接能捕捉出源模式之间的像素级关系,因此可以对强度缩放和噪音敏感. 相形之下,一个地物空间的建模差异可以提供更好的背景表现,反映序列间对比变化.

blocks.en: We propose the Mixture of Feature Difference (MoFD) module that effectively leverages the complementary information from multiple sequences for CE-MRI synthesis. Unlike conventional methods that concatenate sequences across channels, our approach uses an encoder to extract sequence-specific features from each input sequence capturing unique contrast characteristics. We further calculate the feature differences between sequences and dynamically allocate importance to sequence-specific features and their feature differences, enabling flexible and selective feature integration instead of fixed averaging. We validate our method with regression-based and GAN-based approaches to investigate the impact of adversarial training on improving perceptual quality. We also evaluate tumor segmentation performance on the synthesized images using nnU-Net [ 22 ] to assess synthesis quality in tumor regions.

blocks.en: Our Contributions : • We propose a method that explicitly leverages feature differences for multi-sequence MRI, enabling the model to capture distinct contrast variations across MRI sequences. • We introduce the MoFD module to prioritize informative features via adaptive and selective integration. • We analyze the impact of regression-based and GAN-based objectives on CE-MRI synthesis. • We extensively validate our method on UCSF-PDGM and UPENN-GBM datasets for CE-MRI synthesis.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical Image Translation for CE-MRI Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.1 CE-MRI综合医疗图像翻译

blocks.en:
Gadolinium-based contrast agents improve lesion visibility but raise safety concerns, motivating recent studies on CE-MRI synthesis from non-contrast sequences.
However, most existing methods still rely on channel-wise concatenation of input modalities, which can overlook the distinct contrast characteristics of each sequence. Bone et al. [ 5 ] synthesized full-dose T1 contrast-enhanced (T1ce) brain MRI from either non-contrast images or low-dose contrast-enhanced images to reduce concerns related to gadolinium retention and nephrotoxicity [ 34 ] . Their study considered a clinical scenario in which T1, T2-FLAIR, and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images were acquired before contrast injection, followed by a 25% low-dose T1ce scan and an additional 75% injection for the full-dose T1ce reference. The source modalities were concatenated along the channel dimension and used as input.
Chen et al. [ 11 ] proposed a 3D fully convolutional network to synthesize CE-MRI from T1, T2, and ADC images. Although regression-based methods can preserve anatomical structures, they often produce over-smoothed images and struggle to synthesize fine details in localized enhancing lesions. To improve perceptual quality, Jiao et al. [ 24 ] proposed a GAN-based model for synthesizing abdominal contrast-enhanced T1ce images from non-contrast T1 and T2 images, using separate encoders and a sparse attention fusion module to combine modality-specific features.
Li et al. [ 35 ] demonstrated that virtual contrast-enhanced MRI can precisely delineate tumors for nasopharyngeal carcinoma radiotherapy, eliminating the risk of gadolinium-based contrast agent.
Bottani et al. [ 6 ] compared three conditional GAN-based generators for translating non-contrast MRI into CE-MRI, each built on a 3D U-Net backbone with residual connections, attention gates, or transformer layers.
Most existing methods rely on GAN-based frameworks. However, due to the perception-distortion trade-off [ 4 ] , adversarial learning tends to only improve perceptual image quality at the cost of reduced fidelity. This trade-off is important in medical image translation, where fidelity is more critical than perceptual quality. Accordingly, regression losses can be more important than adversarial learning, which primarily aims to improve perceptual quality [ 44 ] .

blocks.en: 2.2 Feature Fusion and Difference Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 特征组合和差异建模

blocks.en:
Medical image translation has been studied to reduce scan time, cost, and patient risk by generating missing or target modalities from acquired sequences [ 13 , 27 , 31 ] . Early methods used convolutional networks and GANs to translate non-contrast sequences into target images, while later studies introduced more advanced fusion strategies to combine complementary information across modalities. For example, Hi-Net [ 55 ] used hybrid feature fusion to capture modality-specific and cross-modal information. Han et al. [ 19 , 18 ] introduced a task-specific fusion method that adaptively weights each modality according to its contribution to the target image.
Rokuss et al. [ 45 ] introduced a difference weighting block to explicitly incorporate visual and temporal changes between baseline and follow-up scans into the model architecture. Their method computed feature-map differences between the two time points and uses them to generate an attention map that emphasizes changed regions.
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) [ 49 ] is an effective module for scaling model capacity while keeping the number of activated parameters during inference relatively small, often leading to improved performance. Oh et al. [ 41 ] interpreted MoE from a control-theoretic perspective, formulating it as a feedback control mechanism that dynamically assigns the influence of each controller according to the current state to optimize the overall system.
Building on these prior studies, we propose a module for CE-MRI synthesis that explicitly computes feature-map differences across modalities and uses a gating network to dynamically select informative features from multi-sequence MRI.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our model architecture is based on the U-Net [ 47 ] , as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Unlike previous approaches that concatenate multi-sequence images along the channel dimension and process them through a single encoder, our model processes each sequence individually to extract distinct features. This strategy allows for the explicit separation of sequence-specific features, which are then utilized for contrast-enhanced image synthesis.
We employ a weight-sharing encoder across all input sequences. This design ensures that different input sequences are mapped into a unified latent feature space under a consistent criterion, while maintaining parameter efficiency [ 36 , 37 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们的模型建筑以U-Net[47]为基础,如图所示。 2,与以往沿通道维度将多序列图像相接并经由单一编码器处理的方法不同,我们的模型逐个处理每个序列以提取出不同的特征. 这一策略允许明确分离出序列特定特征,然后用于对比增强的图像合成.
我们在所有输入序列中使用了分量编码器。 这种设计确保在一致的标准下将不同的输入序列映射成统一的潜伏地物空间,同时保持参数效率[36,37].

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets.
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集。

blocks.en: We used two public datasets: UCSF-PDGM [ 7 , 8 ] and UPenn-GBM [ 1 , 2 ] . For the experiments, the UCSF-PDGM dataset was divided into 210 subjects for training, 23 for validation, and 54 for testing. The UPenn-GBM dataset was divided into 210 training, 21 validation, and 52 testing subjects. Both datasets consist of multi-sequence MRI, including T1, T2, T2-FLAIR, and T1ce images. In addition, both datasets provide glioblastoma tumor masks annotated into whole tumor (WT), enhancing tumor (ET), and tumor core (TC) regions. All volumes were preprocessed with co-registration to the same anatomical template, skull stripping, and resampling to an isotropic resolution of 1 × 1 × 1 ​ mm 3 1\times 1\times 1\text{ mm}^{3} .

UPenn-GBM数据集分为210个培训,21个验证,52个测试课题. 两个数据集都由多序列核磁共振组成,包括T1,T2,T2-FLAIR和T1ce等图像. 此外,两个数据集都提供被附加到整个肿瘤(WT),增强肿瘤(ET)和肿瘤核(TC)区域的胶原瘤口罩. 所有卷被预处理,并用同一解剖模板的同名注册,头骨被剥去,再被复制到同位素分辨率为 1× 1× 1× 1mm 3 1\times 1\text{ mm}^{3}.

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation details.
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行细节。

blocks.en: The model was trained for 500 epochs using the Adam [ 33 ] optimizer with a batch size of 1 and a learning rate of 1e-4. For training and inference, input images were cropped to minimize background regions and adjusted to a spatial resolution of 192 × 192 × 128 192\times 192\times 128 . Our model was built on a 3D U-Net [ 47 ] backbone, with feature channel dimensions set to [32, 64, 128, 256, 512] at each stage. The proposed MoFD module was inserted into the skip connections at all stages, allowing encoder features to be refined before being passed to the corresponding decoder layers.

blocks.en: 4.3 Metrics.

To evaluate image quality, the 3D PSNR and SSIM metrics were used. Perceptual quality was assessed using the LPIPS [ 54 ] metric with a 3D ResNet-50 [ 20 ] trained on RadImageNet [ 39 ] . For downstream evaluation, we trained an nnU-Net [ 22 ] on single-input T1ce images from the training set and evaluated tumor segmentation performance using the Dice score for the WT, ET, and TC regions.

blocks.zh: 4.4 比较方法。

blocks.en: We compared our method with representative MRI synthesis models spanning both 3D and 2D architectures. Among the 3D methods, Ea-GAN [ 53 ] is based on a 3D pix2pix [ 23 ] , Chen et al. HiNet [ 55 ] and MMgSN-Net [ 35 ] are also 2D GAN-based approaches and they incorporate modality fusion modules to integrate information from multiple input modalities.

blocks.en: 5.1 Results on the Comparison Methods
blocks.zh: 5.1 关于比较方法的结果

blocks.en:
We evaluated the performance of T1ce synthesis against baseline models quantitatively (Table 1 ) and qualitatively (Fig. 4 ) on the UCSF-PDGM [ 7 , 8 ] dataset.
Most baseline models were trained using T1, T2, and T2-FLAIR sequences fused via channel-wise concatenation, whereas Hi-Net and MMgSN-Net used the multi-modal fusion strategies proposed in their respective studies.
As shown in Table 1 , our regression-based method (MoFD w/o GAN) achieved the best fidelity performance, with the highest PSNR and SSIM scores. The second-best fidelity results were obtained by Chen et al. [ 11 ] , a regression-based model for T1ce synthesis. In general, models trained with adversarial loss are subject to the perception-distortion trade-off [ 4 ] : they can improve perceptual quality, as reflected by lower LPIPS scores, but often reduce pixel-level fidelity in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Despite this tendency, our GAN-based method (MoFD w/ GAN) remained competitive, achieving the best LPIPS score and the second-best PSNR and SSIM scores on UCSF-PDGM.
Qualitative comparisons in Fig. 4 further support these quantitative findings. While several comparison methods fail to capture detailed tumor appearance, our method reconstructs both anatomical structures and contrast-enhanced tumor regions more faithfully. In particular, Hi-Net struggles to delineate the tumor core region, whereas MMgSN-Net fails to adequately represent the edema component within the whole tumor region. These qualitative observations are consistent with the segmentation results in Table 1 , where the proposed model achieves the best Dice scores for WT, ET, TC, and their average, indicating that its synthesized T1ce images preserve tumor structures more accurately than the comparison methods. A similar trend was observed on the UPENN-GBM dataset, as shown in Fig. 5 and Table 2 .

blocks.en: 5.2 Multi-Sequence Combinations
blocks.zh: 5.2 多序组合

blocks.en:
We investigated the impact of different input sequence combinations on synthesis quality and downstream segmentation performance. We used an nnU-Net [ 22 ] trained on ground truth T1ce images to segment the synthesized T1ce images. Table 3 presents the quantitative comparison.
The model using all sequences (T1, T2, and T2-FLAIR) achieved the highest scores for fidelity, perceptual quality, and downstream segmentation. For segmentation, the model showed high performance for both WT and ET. However, the model showed limited performance on the TC, the smallest of the subregions.
Note that although using only T1 as an input generally improves image fidelity due to its structural consistency with T1ce, it leads to poor segmentation results. This discrepancy arises because T1 images provide insufficient contrast information for distinguishing tumor features. As illustrated in Fig. 6 , the qualitative results confirm that the multi-sequence input enables the model to reconstruct tumor details.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablation Study

blocks.en: MoFD Architecture. Table 4 details the ablation results regarding the architecture of the proposed module (Fig. 2 ). Omitting the convolution block leads to inconsistent feature scales due to the lack of normalization, which negatively affects the synthesis quality. Using a weighted sum to calculate the final output significantly outperforms the approach of averaging features, confirming the effectiveness of our dynamic feature selection mechanism.
blocks.zh: MOFD 建筑学. 表4详细列出了拟议模块结构的削减结果(图2)。 分解出分解块会因不正常化而导致特征尺度不一致,对合成质量有负面影响. 使用加权总和计算出最终产出大大超过了平均特性的方法,证实了我们动态特性选择机制的有效性.

blocks.en: Loss Function. Table 6 presents the ablation study on the three components of ℒ total \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} (Eq. 9 ). Excluding the ℒ gan \mathcal{L}_{\text{gan}} yielded superior fidelity scores in T1ce synthesis. While incorporating the ℒ gan \mathcal{L}_{\text{gan}} improved perceptual quality, it reduced fidelity. Notably, incorporating ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} improved both fidelity and quality metrics in all cases. Interestingly, the regression-based model (w/o ℒ gan \mathcal{L}_{\text{gan}} ) demonstrated better tumor segmentation performance than the GAN-based model. This indicates that although adversarial training improves perceptual realism, it risks introducing realistic but fake details that deviate from the ground truth, thereby degrading segmentation accuracy. Thus, for tasks requiring structural precision, a regression-based approach might be better.

blocks.en: 5.4 Analysis of Feature Selection
blocks.zh: 5.4 特征选择分析

blocks.en: We visualized the features and feature differences produced by the MoFD module, as shown in Fig. 7 . In the tumor region, each feature and feature difference captures the tumor appearance from a different representation. The weighted-sum feature is then generated by adaptively combining these features according to their selection probabilities. Notably, this aggregated feature closely resembles the tumor region in the target image, suggesting that the proposed module effectively extracts complementary representations and dynamically integrates them to produce a final feature representation suitable for target T1ce synthesis.
blocks.zh: 如图7所示,我们可视化了财政部模块产生的特征和特征差异。 在肿瘤区域,每个特征和特征的差异都从不同的代表物中捕捉出肿瘤外观. 然后通过根据这些特征的选取概率进行适应性结合,产生加权和特征. 值得注意的是,这一汇总特征与目标图像中的肿瘤区域非常相近,表明拟议模块有效提取了互补的表示并动态地整合了它们,以产生出适合目标T1ce合成的最终特征表示.

blocks.en: We further visualized which features were selected and passed to the decoder at each scale, as shown in Fig. 8 . At the low-level scales, i.e., scales 0 and 1, the selection probabilities are relatively evenly distributed across the individual features and feature differences, indicating that the MoFD module flexibly selects complementary information to support target synthesis. As the features become deeper, the selection probabilities for T2 and T2-FLAIR tend to increase. This may be because these modalities exhibit contrast patterns similar to T1ce in non-tumor structural regions. However, voxel-level accuracy is particularly important for tumor regions, detailed texture synthesis, and the delineation of enhancing tumor and tumor core regions. Therefore, low-level features can play a more critical role. The relatively balanced feature usage at low-level scales suggests that the proposed module effectively exploits diverse modality-specific and difference-based cues for fine-grained synthesis. This observation is also consistent with Kim et al. [ 26 ] , who showed that coarse layers mainly contribute to forming global image structure, whereas their influence can be reduced when the input image already provides strong structural guidance for image-to-image translation.
blocks.zh: 如图8所示,我们进一步将选择哪些特性并传递到每个尺度的解码器。 在低等尺度,即平分0和平分1,选择概率在单个特征和特征差异之间分布相对均匀,表明MoFD模块灵活选择辅助信息支持目标合成. 随着特征的加深,T2和T2-FLAIR的选取概率往往会增加. 这可能是因为这些模式在非肿瘤结构区域呈现出类似于T1ce的对比模式. 然而,对肿瘤区域,详细的纹理合成,以及增强肿瘤和肿瘤核心区域的分界而言,活体水平的精确度尤为重要. 因此,低级特征可以发挥更关键的作用. 低级尺度相对平衡的特征使用表明,拟议的模块有效地利用了不同模式的特异性和基于差异的提示来进行精细的合成。 此观察也与金等相通. [26],他们显示粗薄的地层主要有助于形成全球图像结构,而当输入图像已经为图像到图像的翻译提供了强大的结构指导时,其影响可以被降低.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose a framework for synthesizing T1ce images from non-contrast multi-sequence MRI using the MoFD module. Instead of relying on simple channel-wise concatenation, MoFD explicitly models both sequence-specific features and their pairwise feature differences, allowing the network to adaptively select complementary information useful for contrast-enhanced image synthesis. Experiments on the UCSF-PDGM and UPenn-GBM datasets showed that our method consistently outperformed baseline approaches in image fidelity and improved downstream tumor segmentation performance. The ablation studies further demonstrated the contribution of the proposed design: feature normalization and dynamic weighting are important for stable fusion, all input sequences and their difference features are beneficial for synthesis quality, and regression-based training can better preserve structural fidelity than adversarial training when accurate tumor representation is required.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个框架,利用MOFD模块,从非相容多序列核磁共振合成T1ce图像. 财政部不依靠简单的信道接合,而是明确模拟序列特性及其对偶特性差异,使网络能够适应性地选择有助于对比增强图像合成的补充信息. 对UCSF-PDGM和UPenn-GBM数据集的实验表明,我们的方法在图像忠贞性方面一贯超过基线方法,并改进了下游肿瘤分解性能。 衰减研究进一步证明了所拟议的设计的贡献:特征正常化和动态加权对于稳定的聚变很重要,所有输入序列及其不同特征都有利于合成质量,回归法培训比对抗性培训在需要准确的肿瘤表现时可以更好地保持结构的忠心.
